name: xldev24-pilot2
selection_method: PIPELINE CHECK, NOT EVIDENCE. The two answerable xldev24 questions with the smallest and the largest gold-page representation, measured by the largest rendered prompt across conditions in a no-call dry run (o200k_base: adubench_single_000266 at 4,244 tokens, adubench_single_001102 at 135,748). Chosen by size only, to exercise a local-model run end to end (timeout, judges, parsing, memory, resume) before the preregistered xldev24 run. Both questions are also in that run, which answers them again; only its answers count.
